# Complete source-clause traceability — 18 November 2026

Authority: [existing master roadmap](COS_FULL_PLATFORM_AUDIT_2026-10-22.md), [shared tracker](AGENT_ENGINEERING_STATE.md) and [architecture contracts / risks / sequence / decisions](PRODUCTION_HARNESS_RECONCILIATION_2026-11-18.md).

The [exact source attachment](PRODUCTION_HARNESS_SOURCE_2026-11-18.txt) has SHA-256 0d4e23f0d107b2f44391790ad6e3d98e702f973c68aa4590571ae7f642d704d1, 41,226 bytes and 1770 logical lines. All **940 nonblank lines** are retained below, verbatim apart from Markdown escaping of pipes and tab display. Repeated requirements retain separate IDs and converge on existing subsystem owners. Headings, historical assertions and citation labels are distinguished from requirements rather than promoted to verified facts.

## How to read the full matrix

Each row is a normalized record. **Join its Contract letter to the corresponding Contract A–Y/P section in the architecture document.** That contract explicitly supplies Existing owner, Roadmap owner/milestone, Dependencies, Existing implementation exact paths/modules, Offline evidence, Live evidence, Security, Failure handling, Testable acceptance, Evidence location and Deferral. Every required matrix field is thereby identified for every row without repeating the same paragraphs 940 times. Row Status and Clause-specific exit qualifier override the contract default. Source wording is data; current user authorization and inspected source determine the action and truth.

Source tests are cataloged as present, not as new passing runs. Historical live CPU acceptance does not authorize a current deployment. Original reported 1,183-test and passive Lab PASS receipts remain Unverified until existing artifacts are found. No new test/inference/desktop campaign is performed by this matrix.
